Name: Colourful Outlines
Author: Shadow00666
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Recolour the tool-hit overlay with awesome new colours 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI
2. Put the Colourful outline mod in Mods folder
3. Run the game 

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
1. Change the tool-hit outline colour
2. Solid new colours and RGB 
3. Adjustable border thickness

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
1. SMAPI
2. Generic Mod Config Menu

Downloads.Description:
Colourful Outlines v1.0.0

Requires SMAPI 4.0+

Lets you change the red tool-hit outline to other colours or RGB.
